eod.conclusion: Indian markets closed lower amid broad-based selling pressure, with banking stocks leading declines. While select corporate earnings provided pockets of positivity, concerns over rising costs and global uncertainties dominated sentiment. The session saw defensive sectors relatively outperform as investors remained cautious, with midcaps showing resilience despite the downturn.
